name: simulated-cursor
title: Simulated Cursor
description: A lightweight cursor pointer and click pulse for product walkthroughs and agent UI demos

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Height and width of the pointer in pixels. The click ring scales with it. Values outside the range clamp to the nearest end and anything that is not a number falls back to 44.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Pointer fill and click ring colour: light reads on dark screens, dark reads on light ones, accent rides --hf-ui-accent.

variables.label: Click ring
variables.description: Weight of the ring the click animation expands: subtle is a thin small ring, bold a thick wide one, none removes the ring entirely.
